title: Brand voice & tone

body.text: Brand voice is the brand's consistent personality in how it speaks — have Claude help
define it from 3–5 adjectives, with do/don't examples
— e.g. 'friendly, confident, no jargon', with example sentences that fit and that don't.

example: "Define the voice for a specialty coffee brand: serious about coffee but fun to talk to / Do: 'This bean is light-roasted, juicy and orange-bright' / Don't: 'A high-quality premium product'"

title: Voice stays, tone adapts

body.text: voice doesn't change, but tone adapts to the situation
— the brand is fun during a promo, but when the system goes down it apologizes sincerely while still being itself. Have Claude write a tone map for each situation.

example: "Write a message for a 1-hour system outage in our brand voice: still friendly but sincere, no jokes while users are in trouble"
